definition: Impossible to solve or explain satisfactorily.
book: The Fall of the House of Usher
author: Edgar Allan Poe
quote: It was a mystery all insoluble; nor could I grapple with the shadowy fancies that crowded upon me as I pondered.
example_sentence: The traffic in town seems an insoluble problem.
